rv.q: Well, the vultures will be disappointed: Lindsay Lohan in non-train-wreck shock.
A good but by no means a great night out whose value does not depend on the swirl of publicity occasioned by the female lead.
Sadly, a revival of no importance that leaves you thirsty for some theatre with a larger purpose than boxoffice returns.
But after all the build-up, the reality is fairly underwhelming.
It wasn’t a particularly moving piece of theatre either and no amount of practice will change that.

cn.t: Lohan's high-profile debut draws mixed reviews in this underwhelming revival. Critics find her performance adequate but unremarkable, while the production itself is deemed uninspired and motivated more by box-office appeal than artistic merit.
